notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28736442/10f298ed2543ca95c5f4aba81f3f83428534a9dc.png

If you have to stay at home and need some new wallpapers to keep your eyes fresh - we got you covered. Get the Runic Rampage Wallpaper and Avatar Pack for free!

The pack consists of:

 4 Worldmap Wallpapers
 4 Character Wallpapers
 4 Story Wallpapers
 2 Avatar Profile Pictures


You find the Pack in the local directory of your Runic Rampage installation. (Right click on the game -> Manage -> Browse local files)

notes.title: Spring Update: Winning Streak!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/0543b0112defc3e1683d3f763368ac655c846beb.png
Heya Warriors!

Challenge yourself and test your fighting skills - how many random levels can you beat in a row? Find out in the all new game mode Winning Streak.

How does Winning Streak work?

Start in Streak level 1
Beat one random level
Level up to Streak level 2
Beat two random levels in a row
Level up to Streak level 3
Beat three random levels in a row
Lost a game? Keep your Streak level and try again!
How far can you make it?

Like New Game Advanced, Winning Streak game mode is accessible after playing through the campaign.


Upcoming achievements

Winning Streak game mode comes with new achievements, wich unlock at 90 reviews! :)
So, Please write a review, claim your Winning Streak achievements and help to unlock more future updates.
Happy smashing! :)

Update: I just added 7 new Achievements :)

Best.
Alex

notes.title: New Game Advanced Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/14583508036e397ddf931bc834641640c7e2dd4f.png
Greetings Warriors!

You asked for it in the discussions and now it is there: Prove that you are the dwarf you claim to be and beat the game in New Game Advanced. 

New Game Advanced in detail

Restart the game in a higher difficulty
Increase your maximum attribute points from 40 to 80
Keep your character level and stats
Recollect gold, weapons and sets
Earn prestige
Beat it in tier 1? Try to beat it in tier 2!
Start over


Please write a review - this helps me to keep the game alive! :)
Thanks and have fun! :)

Best,
Alex

notes.title: Recap, Patches and More!
notes.content:
Hi there,

today it's one month since release. Runic Rampage was well received by the press and is very positive rated here on Steam, which is super awesome! Thank you all! :)

Trading Cards
I integrated trading cards. Take a glimpse:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/9564a22a422d8e90040c9cd1aea9bc9556327419.png

Patches
I released two minor updates with bug-fixes. List of changes:

Patch 1.0.2 - 13 June 2017

fixed pausing when losing focus in dual monitor setup
fixed sometimes statistic shows wrong max combo 


Patch 1.0.1 - 19 May 2017
fixed 2nd screen darkens on dual monitor setup
fixed tutorial started with gamepad button instead mouse button when using mouse


Coming soon
I am currently working on a major update with features requested in the discussions, as well as new language support. Stay tuned!

If you like Runic Rampage and want to support my work: Please write a review. :)

Best.
Alex
